name: usage-stats
description: Pane, status line and /usage-stats command showing rate limits, time-to-limit, per-model tokens, cost and usage history, combinable across machines through a synced folder

syncFolder.title: Sync folder
syncFolder.description: A folder your machines share through Dropbox, iCloud Drive, OneDrive or similar, e.g. ~/Dropbox/claude-usage. Each machine writes its own file there and the pane adds them all up. Leave empty to keep history on this machine only.

machineName.title: Machine name
machineName.description: How this machine is labelled in the per-machine breakdown. Empty uses the host name.

subscriptionUsd.title: Subscription price (USD/month)
subscriptionUsd.description: What your Claude plan costs per month, e.g. 20, 100 or 200. Turns on the Subscription value section: API-equivalent cost of your recorded usage against this price. 0 hides it.

billingDay.title: Billing day
billingDay.description: Day of the month your plan renews (1-31; a short month renews on its last day). Sets the billing period the value is measured over.
